topics.title: Tarbela Dam
topics.summary: Tarbela ko Indus River aur Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke saath yaad rakhein. Yeh earth-filled dam hai; sawal mein river, province aur dam ki qisam ko alag pehchanein.

topics.title: Mangla Dam
topics.summary: Mangla Dam Jhelum River par hai. Tarbela ke saath confuse na karein: Tarbela ka river Indus hai, jabke Mangla ka Jhelum.

topics.title: Warsak Dam
topics.summary: Warsak Kabul River par Peshawar ke qareeb Khyber Pakhtunkhwa mein hai. Is ke mukhtalif development phases aur generating units ki commissioning ko aik hi waqia na samjhein.

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0160-Q066-SIM: Wazahat: existing MCQ ka answer 1960 hai, lekin WAPDA pehle chaar generating units ki commissioning 1960-61 batata hai. Phase ki completion aur tamam units ki commissioning ki wording ko alag dekhein; 1960 ko har unit ki aik hi tareekh na samjhein.

topics.title: Diamer-Bhasha Dam
topics.summary: Diamer-Bhasha project Indus River par Chilas ke qareeb hai. Capacity wale sawal mein planned capacity poochi gayi hai; is ko mojooda bijli ki paidawar na samjhein.

topics.title: Diamer-Bhasha aur Mohmand Dams Fund
topics.summary: Yeh July 2018 ke dams fund ki tareekh se mutalliq sawalat hain. Fund ke qayam ki tareekh ko dam ki tameer ya takmeel ki tareekh se alag rakhein.

references.title: State Bank: Supreme Court Diamer Bhasha and Mohmand Dams Fund, 2018
Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Dams Fund press release, 16 July 2018

topics.title: Hub Dam
topics.summary: Hub Dam, Hub River par hai aur Sindh aur Balochistan dono ko faida deta hai. Is liye isay sirf aik province ka project samajhne ke bajaye inter-provincial project ke taur par yaad rakhein.

topics.title: Mirani Dam
topics.summary: Mirani Dam ko Dasht River, Turbat aur Balochistan ke saath jor kar yaad karein. Aik hi project par river, qareebi shehar aur province ke mukhtalif sawal bante hain.

topics.title: Gomal Zam Dam
topics.summary: Gomal Zam Dam, Gomal River par South Waziristan ke ilaqe mein hai. Yeh pani store karne, aabpashi aur hydropower se mutalliq project hai.

topics.title: Nai Gaj Dam
topics.summary: Nai Gaj project Gaj River par Dadu ke qareeb Sindh mein hai. Is group ka bunyadi rabta project, district headquarters aur province hai; yahan live construction status track nahi hota.

topics.title: Khanpur Dam
topics.summary: Khanpur Dam Haro River par hai. Is ka pani Islamabad aur Rawalpindi ki municipal supply ke saath aabpashi mein bhi istemal hota hai.

references.title: WAPDA Annual Report 2022-23: Khanpur Dam Project

topics.title: Simly Dam
topics.summary: Simly Dam Soan River par hai aur Islamabad ko pani faraham karta hai. Is ka river Soan yaad rakhein; Rawal Dam ka river Korang hai.

references.title: PCRWR: Water Quality Profile of Surface Water Bodies, 2022

topics.title: Rawal Dam aur Rawal Lake
topics.summary: Rawal Dam Korang River par bana hai aur is ka reservoir Rawal Lake hai. Islamabad mein location aur Rawalpindi ko pani ki supply do alag points hain.

references.title: PCRWR: Water Quality Profile of Surface Water Bodies, 2022
Federal Flood Commission: National Register of Dams, 2018

topics.title: Satpara Dam aur Lake
topics.summary: Satpara ka taalluq Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan se hai. Lake ke qareebi shehar aur dam ke pani se faida uthane wale shehar ko saath parhein.

topics.title: Wali Tangi Dam
topics.summary: Wali Tangi Dam Quetta ke mashriq mein Urak Valley, Balochistan mein hai. Is group mein Quetta aur Balochistan ko aik hi location ke shehar aur province ke taur par yaad karein.

references.title: Pakistan Tourism Development Corporation: Wali Tangi Dam Lake

topics.title: Banjosa Lake: artificial reservoir
topics.summary: Banjosa, Poonch ke ilaqe ki artificial lake hai. Artificial reservoir aur qudrati lake ke farq par tawajjoh dein; yeh topic zaroori nahi ke bara hydroelectric dam ho.

references.title: Pakistan Tourism Development Corporation: Banjosa Lake

topics.title: WAPDA: pani aur bijli ka idara
topics.summary: WAPDA ka poora naam Water and Power Development Authority hai. Yeh 1958 mein qaim hua; is ke qayam ko kisi aik dam ki construction date se alag yaad rakhein.

topics.title: Sukkur Barrage aur Nara Canal
topics.summary: Sukkur Barrage Sindh mein Indus River par hai aur 1932 se operational hai. Nara Canal isi barrage se nikalti hai; barrage aur canal ko aik rabte mein yaad karein.

references.title: Sindh Irrigation: Sukkur Barrage Left Bank Region

topics.title: Guddu Barrage
topics.summary: Guddu Barrage Sindh ki shumali taraf Indus River par hai. Is se nikalne wale feeders aabpashi ke liye pani taqseem karte hain.

topics.title: Kotri / Ghulam Muhammad Barrage
topics.summary: Kotri Barrage ka tareekhi naam Ghulam Muhammad Barrage hai aur yeh Indus River par hai. Is ke naam, river aur 1955 ki takmeel ko aik group mein parhein.

topics.title: Trimmu Barrage
topics.summary: Trimmu Jhang ke qareeb Chenab aur Jhelum ke sangam se neeche hai. Barrage ka river Chenab hai, jabke confluence mein milne wala doosra river Jhelum hai; dono sawal aik jaisay nahi.

topics.title: Khanki Barrage aur Lower Chenab Canal
topics.summary: Khanki Barrage Punjab mein Chenab River par hai aur Lower Chenab Canal ko pani deta hai. District wale sawal mein diye gaye 2025 ke record ka hawala aham hai; administrative boundaries waqt ke saath badal sakti hain.

references.title: Punjab Irrigation PMO: New Khanki Barrage

topics.title: Taunsa Barrage
topics.summary: Taunsa Barrage Indus River par Punjab mein hai. Province ke sawal mein isay Sindh ke Sukkur, Guddu aur Kotri barrages se alag rakhein.

references.title: Tourism Development Corporation of Punjab: Taunsa Barrage

topics.title: Chashma Barrage aur Chashma-Jhelum Link Canal
topics.summary: Chashma-Jhelum Link Canal, Chashma Barrage par Indus ke baen kinare se nikal kar pani Jhelum ki taraf le jati hai. Isay Chashma Right Bank Canal se alag pehchanein.

references.title: WAPDA Annual Report 2022-23: Chashma Barrage and CJ-Link Canal
